name: Gokul K.
text: It was a very good experience for me to know more about the ways in which cinema works and to understand the workflow of a cinematic editor from a filmmaker himself.The concepts were very clear and enjoyed the course.

program: Learn The Art of Editing - Short Films, Ad films and Music Videos
name: Mani N.
text: I loved how editing was explained differently for each format short films, music videos, ad films, trailers, and feature films. The session clearly showed how rhythm, pacing, emotion, and structure change based on purpose. It helped me understand why we edit a certain way, not just how.

program: Learn The Art of Editing - Short Films, Ad films and Music Videos
name: Hema D.
text: The Level Up workshops and advanced courses have been instrumental in refining my editing skills and transforming my approach to filmmaking. I've gained valuable insights and knowledge that have greatly benefited my craft.

program: Learn The Art of Editing - Short Films, Ad films and Music Videos
name: Mamidi V.
text: The way he kept each type like music videos, ad films, feature film in a different instead of treating all as one

name: George D.
text: It was great getting to learn new things about video editing. How an editor can convert the footages into something meaningful and and understanding to the audience

name: Pritish
text: This workshop gives a completely overview of how editing industry works. It will make us more watchful for the detailing while watching movies or videos and we can learn lot more

name: Kashish
text: The way they explained everything with examples with proper picture video showing, for example like L cuts , fade everything with examples made it easier to understand things more clearly. Also the way he was interacting with us was apt.

name: Arjun Y.
text:
I really like the way the various aspects and techniques of filmmaking were shared in the workshop, and the explanation of DaVinci Resolve as well.
I think this is a really good starting point for beginners to learn about Video Editing, and even those with experience can get to learn or refresh their knowledge from such a workshop! :D

name: Gandhesh K.
text: I liked that the workshop was cleverly divided into parts that answered to the questions that would have been circling my mind. Also comprehensive talks about the roles that one would pursue later on.

name: Hyndavi R.
text: I like the fact that they don't waste much time on unnecessary details. And we actually learnt something useful. It's like going into the behind the scenes of the creative process. As a newcomer with a lost of interest to create videos, it was the perfect about of information and intensity. They were successful in making me sit for 3 hours at a stretch. And I think it's an achievement in itself for getting started.
